heading: Wednesday, December 20, 2023
topLine: Explainable deep learning identifies a new structural class of antibiotics active against MRSA.

items.headline: Explainable deep learning identifies a new structural class of antibiotics active against MRSA
items.summary: MIT and Broad Institute researchers (Felix Wong, Erica Zheng, James Collins) trained graph neural networks on about 39,000 tested compounds, screened roughly 12 million molecules, and used substructure explanations to flag candidate chemical classes. Published in Nature: two compounds from one class reduced MRSA burden about tenfold in mouse skin and systemic infection models and showed low toxicity to human cells; they remain preclinical.

image.alt: Fig. 1: ensembles of deep learning models predicting antibiotic activity and human-cell cytotoxicity
